![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The regex replacement `.replace(/\bsin\^2\b/g, 'sine squared')` on line 175 is redundant and unreachable.

Since `.replace(/\bsin\b/g, 'sine')` is executed on line 173, any occurrence of `sin^2` (where `sin` is bounded by word boundaries) will already have been converted to `sine^2`. Consequently, the pattern on line 174 (`/\bsine\^2\b/`) will match and replace it with `sine squared`, leaving nothing for the pattern on line 175 to match. Removing the redundant line simplifies the normalization pipeline.

```suggestion
    .replace(/\bsine\^2\b/g, 'sine squared')
```
Fixed in 61d1bc9bf: removed the unreachable `sin^2` replacement after `sin` is normalized to `sine`, and added a focused regression check for the normalization pipeline.
